title: Cool Flames Investigation (CFI)
scientific_focus: Liquid-droplet combustion; cool flames and low-temperature chemistry
objectives: Understand low-temperature fuel-oxidation chemistry and persistent cool-flame burning after conventional hot flames become extinguished.
approach: Ignite liquid fuel droplets using combustion hardware aboard the ISS; change fuel and ambient gas conditions and track droplet lifetime, burning behavior, and transitions between hot flames and cool flames.
status_message: No data available for this investigation yet. Graphs cannot be generated.
